title:
Epic to enable or disable the submit button on the {@link FailureModeRecommendation} form based on whether
the recommendation text has changed from the original value.

This epic monitors INPUT_CHANGE and FORM_RESET events on the form and compares the current recommendation value
with the original value stored in the {@link AssetOnboardingFailureModeApplicationState}. The submit
button is only enabled when there are actual changes to the recommendation text and the text is not empty.

Called from Reliability.AssetClassDetailFailureModeDetailRecommendedActionsSidePanelForm
name: UiSdlEpicEnableDisableRecommendationFormSubmitButton
